three.js r170 (0.170.0), MIT licence (LICENSE). Only the files the game imports, and what they import, copied unchanged from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/ so the game does not depend on a CDN at play time.

To update: change the version, re-copy the same set of files (the importmaps in the html files point here), and check the game.
